assertion_analysis.fails_if: The declared three trips are dropped, reordered, assigned another residual or mask difference, or unavailable damping is exposed as true; restoring the old function crashes on its scalar indexing.

The receipt invents inner decisions or promotion records from the unavailable scalar defaults; these are output-empty contracts, with production trace availability independently confirmed by the populated per-trip history.
The executed prefix includes padding or mispairs any residual/mask/damping value; restoring bool(-1) gives [false,true,true] instead of [false,true,null], which is recorded in the negative control.

Any short array, non-sentinel scalar damping, or two-dimensional mask is accepted or raises an exception without the alignment marker and offending field; the parameter matrix supplies five distinct invalid histories.
Zero executed trips fabricate a trip or a nonzero count; the original implementation also passes this boundary case and the negative log preserves that one pass.
A negative trip count silently constructs an empty history rather than issuing the named refusal; the original function does exactly that and the negative log reports DID NOT RAISE.
